critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (still present from previous iterations, not blocking): UsersAdminPage.js renders <span> as a child of <option>, causing React hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Cosmetic only.

/app/backend/modules/bots/routes.py: ROADKILL_FALLBACK dict is mutated via dict(ROADKILL_FALLBACK) copy each time which is fine, but the is_fallback key is only present on the fallback shape. Frontend code already handles missing-key as falsy (good). Consider always including is_fallback: false for symmetry/clearer contract.
seed_data_creation: Test temporarily set admin avatar to Harry's locked avatar then restored to original. Bot-harry avatar selection was also exercised (already its own avatar). Marieke's avatar untouched because the 403 was correctly thrown before any state change.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ronde 2 deel 1 + Avatar polish fully validated. Key new endpoints: GET /api/bots/community/archive (tree mode default; with year+month+day returns day messages); GET /api/bots/community/recap (offset_days or date query). Chat intent 'community_recap' detected by smart_intents_service after agenda intent; supports vandaag (offset 0), gisteren (1), eergisteren (2). Locked avatars enforce bot_owner equality - admin (user-001) bypasses. ROADKILL_LOGO_URL = /api/avatar/gallery/roadkill-logo/image. Avatar object on community messages only carries is_fallback when it IS a fallback (key absent for real avatars).
